image_description: A modern architectural interior featuring a staircase with metal handrails and balusters. The stairs are made of light-colored stone or concrete, leading up to a landing with wooden paneling in the background. The railing system consists of sleek, tubular metal handrails supported by vertical metal posts (balusters) and anchored by thicker square metal newel posts at the base. The perspective is from the bottom of the stairs looking up.
